title: What Is a Conventional Home Loan? The Complete First-Time Buyer Mortgage Guide

faqs.q: What exactly is a conventional home loan?
faqs.a: A conventional home loan is a mortgage not insured by the federal government, offered by private lenders like banks or credit unions.

faqs.q: What is the 2026 conforming loan limit in Arizona?
faqs.a: For 2026, the conforming loan limit for a single-family home in Arizona is $806,500.

faqs.q: What credit score is needed for a conventional loan?
faqs.a: A minimum credit score of 620 is usually required to qualify for a conventional loan.
